instruction: I need to increase my browser's default text size for better readability. Please change Chrome's default font size to 18 pixels.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome's default font size to 18 pixels in settings (chrome://settings/fonts). Uses existing check_font_size metric and get_chrome_font_size getter. Same difficulty level - navigating to settings and modifying a single numeric parameter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome's Preferences file and extracts default_font_size from webkit.webprefs settings
Metric logic correctly compares the extracted font size with the expected value of 18 using exact equality check
Expected value (18 pixels) matches exactly what the instruction requires
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing font size to 18 pixels, evaluator verifies exactly this requirement
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted and can be read from the Preferences file
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts font size dict -> metric extracts default_font_size -> compares with expected value
No logical issues, edge cases, or missing requirements
